answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 56311 Country: India Title: NIKAH Question: One woman's husband died, now she wants to marry. Can she marry with her brother-in-law (husband's younger brother)? Kindly guide me. Answer ID: 56311 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 17/28/L=01/1436) Yes, it is valid to marry the brother-in-law after passing iddah of death. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
